topic.title: Limitations of the BiDi Support
topic.shortdesc: Known limitations when editing bidirectional (BiDi) documents in .

body.p: supports editing bidirectional (BiDi) documents, but with the following limitations:

ul.li:
Ligatures are broken in the following case:
Part of a word is surrounded by an element. This works correctly in Chrome when the Tags Display Mode is set to No Tags.
A tag can point in the wrong direction when elements that contain both RTL (Right to Left) and LTR (Left to Right) content are rendered.
Tables cannot be resized in RTL (Right to Left) documents.
